title: Al-Ihkam fi Usul al-Ahkam (Ibn Hazm)
author: ibn-hazm
attributionNote: The attribution is the one the manuscript tradition and the scholarship give.
description: Ibn Hazm's theory of law: language and meaning, the authority of the Qur'an and of solitary hadith reports, consensus, and long chapters against analogy, juristic preference and imitation. It is the theoretical companion to al-Muhalla.
historicalContext: The work is the principal statement of Zahiri method, and its arguments against analogy were answered by jurists of every other school.
availabilityNote: Arabic text only, streamed from OpenITI at read time. No English translation is included because no public-domain English translation was verified. Only the catalogue record, chapter outline and passage index are held here.
